Handler: Any news, spare blankets before lunch
Coordinator: I have checked the Companion Animal Travel Desk queue and confirmed that comfort notes are filed.
Planner: Please keep the welfare checklist ready and remind staff to give clear guidance before departure.
Dispatcher: The crate review is complete, and the cabin team has been briefed on quiet loading.
Coordinator: Maintain calm handling, verify water access, and update me on any change in behavior.
Trainer: I will restock the soft liners and keep the spare blankets within reach for each transfer.
Planner: Ensure Aurelia Skyways procedures are followed and note any special needs in the record.
Coordinator: The welfare coordinator should review each animal comfort need before handover.
Handler: Understood, and I will keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk organized for the next arrival.
